# Dvergr extractor

Type: Material | Internal ID: DvergrNeedle | Source: Dvergr component crate | Usage: Placing, Sap extractor | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): No

# Introduction

The Dvergr extractor is an item found in the Mistlands. It is a key component in the creation of Sap extractors. Unlike other miscellaneous materials, it cannot be teleported without a Portal stone.

## Availability

Dvergr extractors can be found in the Dvergr component crates that spawn in inhabited Dvergr settlements in the Mistlands.

### Building

• Sap extractor

## Notes

Breaking the crates that contain these extractors directly will anger the nearby Dvergr. Destroying it indirectly by ramming it with a cart or luring hostile mobs to them does not.

Categorias: Materials, Can't be Teleported
